part.text:
Implemented the Unix signal driver fix in `tokio/src/signal/unix/driver.rs`.

- Registered the self-pipe receiver with `Interest::READABLE` only.
- Removed the unused writable interest that can cause continuous polling under level-triggered selectors.
- Did not modify tests or stage/commit changes.

Validated in the supplied container with:

```sh
cargo test -p tokio --features full --test signal_drop_recv --test signal_drop_signal --test signal_drop_rt --test signal_multi_rt --test signal_no_rt --test signal_notify_both --test signal_panic --test signal_twice --test signal_usr1
```

All 9 signal integration tests passed. The build emitted existing `unexpected cfg` warnings only.
